title: AMALIA Technical Report: A Fully Open Source Large Language Model for European Portuguese

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model generations using the P3B3 (pt-PT-pt-BR Bias Benchmark) dataset, which consists of multi-turn, variant-agnostic conversational prompts. An automated LLM judge (Gemini 2.5-Pro) assesses the linguistic features of the model's responses to determine whether its grammatical structures and lexical variations align more with European Portuguese (pt-PT) or Brazilian Portuguese (pt-BR).
